name: Burn Rate
description: Not a published list: built so the sweeps reach Esâ Afontov: Eco-Insurrectionist, Midnight Sun's Anarch identity, which answers the first core damage each turn with a card and a sabotage 2, and the Anarch cards of Midnight Sun Stage 3. On Pay As You Go's frame after Midnight Sun Stage 2, its identity swapped, so Running Hot and Marrow are the identity's fuel: two Begemot for its two Take a Dive, a fracter that costs a core damage and grows with every one; two Ghosttongue for its two Time Bomb, another core damage that makes every event a credit cheaper; and two The Twinning for its two Friend of a Friend, charged by the credits Cyberfeeder, The Toolbox and Crash Space hold and spent on extra accesses. Pay As You Go keeps every card given up here. Midnight Sun Stage 7a: two Steelskin Scarring for its two Raindrops Cut Stone, an event that draws again when the core damage its own deck takes trashes it from the grip; Pay As You Go keeps Raindrops Cut Stone. Midnight Sun Stage 8b: two Light the Fire! for its two Valentina Ferreira Carvalho, a resource for a resource, a core damage paid for a remote run that trashes its root; Pay As You Go keeps Valentina. Uprising Stage 1: two Moshing for its two Chastushka, three grip cards trashed for 3[credit] and three more; Pay As You Go keeps Chastushka. Uprising Stage 3: a Buffer Drive for one of its two Hush, one of the cards its own Moshing or a core damage trashes from the grip back to the bottom of the stack; Pay As You Go and Side Quest keep Hush. Downfall Stage 3: two Demolisher for two Marrow, a console that takes a credit off every Corp card's trash cost and pays one back on the turn's first trash. Downfall Stage 5: two Chisel for two Hantu, a Trojan that loads a virus counter at each encounter with its host, each taking a point of the host's strength, until it trashes the host at 0; Pay As You Go and Side Quest keep Hantu.
